title: Six-Day_Mixed-Equipment_Full-Body_Tabata_Week_OPTIMIZED (1)
author: Joel  M.
desc:
The purpose of a full-body Tabata-style resistance workout like the one we built is to combine resistance training with very high training density. You're trying to stimulate essentially every major muscle group while keeping rest short enough that the session also places a substantial demand on your cardiovascular and metabolic systems.

For your specific program — 8 rounds of 20 seconds work/10 seconds rest for each exercise, one exercise per muscle group, 8–10 reps per round, stopping at form failure — several goals are happening simultaneously.
